verdict.rationale: Datadog documents a public API Reference, with an agent-oriented markdown version and an llms.txt index, plus an official MCP Server. Together these give an external agent first-party, documented access to the platform. The evidence pack contains only titles and pointers, so it never states which endpoints or MCP tools query metrics, logs and traces, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the API and MCP server expose metric, log and trace queries; a machine-readable OpenAPI spec; independent or hands-on corroboration of agents debugging production this way.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an external agent query metrics, logs, and traces through documented APIs to debug production

citations.quote: For AI agents: A markdown version of this page is available at https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest.md
